{{Quote|We've got company&hellip; a small vanguard of Sith fighters, coming in hard!|Carth Onasi|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''Sith fighter''', also known as the '''Sith interceptor''', was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that formed the bulk of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak]]'s space forces during the [[Jedi Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Sithfighter_aft.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Sith fighter, aft view, showing engines]]
The design and manufacture of the Sith fighter was a hybrid of various technologies&mdash;untraceable to any products originating from known [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]&mdash;unique to the<ref name="SFITDB" /> [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Space station/Legends|space-based shipyard]],<ref name="KOTOR" /> the [[Star Forge]].<ref name="SFITDB" /> A single-seater [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]], with a cargo capacity of forty [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and provisions for one [[Standard day/Legends|day]],<ref name="KOTORCG" /> the craft had not been designed with the comfort<ref name="SFITDB" /> or safety of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in mind. Mass-produced to be small, lightweight, and agile, the integrity of the fighter's [[Hull/Legends|hull]] was minimal, as were the life support systems. The pilot did not need to wear a full [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuit]]; however, many chose to do so since there was a significant chance that the pilot would need to eject from a damaged craft.<ref name="KOTORCG" />

The fighter was powered by a prototype [[Twin ion engine/Legends|twin ion drive system]]<ref name="SFITDB" /><ref name="CSWE" /> of Rakatan origin<ref name="CSWE" />&mdash;seen only in this design<ref name="SFITDB" />&mdash;that allowed it to reach speeds of 1,250 [[Kilometer/Legends|km]]/[[Standard hour/Legends|h]].<ref name="KOTORCG" /> The power generated by the dual [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and thrusters afforded the fighter maneuverability nearly to the point of instability, therefore requiring that much of the central chassis was given to managing the reactor core for optimal performance.<ref name="SFITDB" />

The Sith fighter's design consisted of a short, stubby carriage that housed the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] and subsystems. A feature exclusive to this design was the fighter's ability to to fold its wings and power down its weapon systems when docked or traversing long distances in order to conserve energy. Engaging in combat, the wings unfolded&mdash;giving the craft a maximum length of 7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]&mdash;and the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], one at each outward edge, were brought to bear. This allowed the fighter a broad attack arc, while its small forward and rear profiles made it difficult to target.<ref name="SFITDB" />

==Role==
The manufacturing capabilities of the Star Forge allowed for the Sith fighter to be mass-produced, and the versatile design of the fighter ensured that craft were capable of being tightly packed in the cargo bays of their mothership,<ref name="SFITDB" /> the [[Centurion-class battlecruiser/Legends|''Centurion''-class battlecruiser]],<ref name="KOTORCG" /> and launched moments after the carrier exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="SFITDB" /> <div style="float:right">[[File:FoldedSithFighters.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Sith fighters with wings folded]]</div>

==History==
The Sith fighter first appeared as Malak and Revan returned to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] as conquerors after the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> While many of their [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] were turncoat Republic vessels, the majority of their forces were made of these fighters. Produced by the [[Star Forge]], they could be easily stored in cargo bays, such that even a single mothership could deliver swarms of them into battle. Furthermore, they were quick to scramble, making them a deadly first strike.<ref name="SFITDB" /> 

===New Sith Wars===
Several centuries after the conclusion of the Jedi Civil War, the [[Daimanate]] forces employed their own [[Daiman's ship|starfighters]] that closely resembled Sith fighters.<ref name="Knight Errant 0">[[Knight Errant 0|''Knight Errant'' 0]]</ref>
